description: This file defines a class for handling security errors related to disallowed tags in Twig templates within the sandbox security feature.

classes.name: SecurityNotAllowedTagError
classes.description: An exception class indicating a disallowed tag used in a Twig template's sandbox security context.

methods.name: __construct
methods.description: Constructor that initializes the error with a message and the name of the disallowed tag.

methods.name: getTagName
methods.description: Returns the name of the disallowed tag that caused this security error.
